specs.title: reordering and insertion: state maps by identity, not index
closed state is preserved (client default open, user had it closed)
missing target: no guessing for details or focus
ambiguous target (duplicate identity in client) is left untouched
focus follows the same link after insertion, and nav scopes disambiguate same-text links
first-HTML fallback preserved: shell stays when client content is not ready
CLI starts its own loopback server, responds, and only that child is cleaned up
